query:
SELECT u.id, u.name, u.email, u.role, mp.module, mp.accessLevel
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN modulePermissions mp ON u.id = mp.userId
WHERE u.name LIKE '%irolos%' OR u.email LIKE '%irolos%'
ORDER BY u.id, mp.module;
